forbidden_transitions.reason: Must obtain release-to-handle and fixture release receipts.
New qualified repair/reuse inspection is required, with a new version.

object_state_binding: Every operation occurrence binds object ID/version and before/after state snapshots. A global state label cannot substitute for object-specific receipts.
conditional_acceptance: Inspection/commit produces a record. Acceptance is produced only by explicit qualified checks; source-target agreement is not an acceptance condition.
